title: Architecture: CellphoneS Retail Analytics Pipeline
description: BI-ready analytics pipeline for Vietnamese phone retail chain (CellphoneS) with string-first CSV ingestion, Star Schema warehouse, 68 structured quality checks, and Power BI semantic model with 35+ DAX measures.

nodes.label: Sales Transactions
nodes.description: 1,815 transaction records with product, store, quantity, revenue

nodes.label: Inventory Snapshots
nodes.description: 1,350 periodic inventory records with stock levels

nodes.label: Product Catalog
nodes.description: 10 phone products with brand, category, cost

nodes.label: Store Directory
nodes.description: 15 stores with region, RSM, AM hierarchy

nodes.label: String-first Reader
nodes.description: All CSVs read as dtype='string' to preserve leading zeros, then explicit type coercion via ColumnSpec contracts

nodes.label: Data Cleansing
nodes.description: Deduplication, quarantine-first approach for conflicts, return handling with sign preservation

nodes.label: Quality Framework
nodes.description: 68 structured checks: schema compliance, null detection, uniqueness, FK integrity, inventory balance, grain validation

nodes.label: Star Schema
nodes.description: 3 dimensions (date, store, product) + 3 facts (sales, inventory, target) + 1 operations mart

nodes.label: Parquet Output
nodes.description: Snappy-compressed Parquet for production BigQuery/Power BI ingestion

nodes.label: CSV Export
nodes.description: UTF-8-SIG CSV for human inspection and audit

nodes.label: Power BI Semantic Model
nodes.description: 35+ DAX measures: revenue, target achievement, inventory status, reconciliation, ranking
